market.domesticSlice: Gravita India (listed): 9M FY26 revenue ₹3,093 Cr (+9%), PAT ₹286 Cr (+31%), 13 global facilities, ₹1,500 Cr capex plan through FY28 targeting 700,000+ MTPA capacity. Pondy Oxides & Chemicals (listed): Q1 FY26 revenue ₹604.22 Cr (+35.56% YoY), PAT +94.21% to ₹25.17 Cr.

structureFacts: Steel Scrap Recycling Policy 2019 (Ministry of Steel) promotes Metal Scrapping Centers facilitating both ferrous and non-ferrous scrap recycling

Vehicle Scrappage Policy (MoRTH) allows scrapping of vehicles >15 years old, directly increasing supply of aluminium/copper/steel scrap from end-of-life vehicles, tied into Extended Producer Responsibility push for OEMs
Secondary aluminium production uses up to 95% less energy than primary production — a structural ESG/cost tailwind driving sector investment
Automotive lightweighting and EV adoption structurally increase demand for secondary aluminium alloys (die-cast components)

adoptionStructure.note: Automotive OEMs and die-casters need just-in-time liquid metal supply to eliminate their own ingot-remelting step and reduce melt loss, consistent alloy chemistry/purity for safety-critical components, documented recycled-content/environmental compliance, and cost savings vs. primary aluminium (LME-linked pricing).
